name: Cambi
summary: Cambi is a cartoony horror VR game set in a creepy, colorful world. Explore eerie environments, solve puzzles, and avoid terrifying creatures that stalk you. With its fast-paced gameplay and spooky atmosphere, Cambi combines the fun of GorillaTag movement-based VR with thrilling moments of horror. Can you survive the horrors lurking around every corner?
